title: Optimizing What Policies Learn From: Recoverability-aware Rollout Intervention Learning
summary: Optimizing What Policies Learn From: Recoverability-aware Rollout Intervention Learning｜Critic-free group-based reinforcement learning has become a scalable approach for post-train

extra.description: Critic-free group-based reinforcement learning has become a scalable approach for post-training large language models. However, most existing methods allocate the same number of rollouts to every task and trajectory state, even though some rollouts provide much more useful learning signals than others.
